recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-9793 unless PA separately reopens Encounter.class terminology or the THO EncounterClass value set.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 issue asked PA to resolve the unclear Daytime code in the required Encounter Class value set by replacing the local FHIR-defined class code binding with an extensible v3 ActEncounterCode coding-based binding.
initial_application: Commit 4a6a3e7a00257340bec67fe3186073ce734f8f1a applied the original tracker by changing the Encounter spreadsheet binding to v3 ActEncounterCode/extensible and updating Encounter examples from local class codes to v3 ActCode codings.
additional_context: Encounter is active in the current build. Later Published decisions intentionally changed the exact seed shape: FHIR-32342 made Encounter.class CodeableConcept, FHIR-32341 made it 0..* with a preferred binding to a smaller EncounterClass value set, UP-344 implemented that value set in THO, FHIR-39147 fixed the canonical URL to terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/encounter-class, and FHIR-39014 rejected reverting to required/extensible ActEncounterCode.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Encounter source has no Daytime/local FHIR Encounter Class binding and matches the later final PA/UTG decisions.
